name: Maclure Vineyards
summary: In southern Elwynn, grapes and wine from Maclure Vineyards go to Stormwind. The Maclure estate is known for its harvest and its bitter feud with the neighboring Stonefields.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: In southern Elwynn Forest, the Maclures tend their fields and make wine. Yet the Stonefields, who live down the road, cast a shadow over that daily labor. Accusations of theft and old resentment keep tempers high between the households. Hungry boars prowl the land, while kobolds press toward both homesteads.

sections.title: A Forbidden Romance
sections.body: Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield have secretly fallen in love, though their families are bitter enemies. They meet in hidden groves, away from their parents' watchful eyes. Travelers through the vineyards carry secret messages, settle petty grievances, and help the young couple seek a life together beyond their families' grudge.

faq.q: Why are the Maclures and Stonefields fighting?
aliases: why do they hate each other
faq.answer: The Maclures and Stonefields have feuded for years, driven by mistrust, petty accusations, and stubborn pride. Each blames the other for lost goods and livestock, though neither has proof of foul play.

Maybell is the daughter of the Maclure household. She has secretly fallen in love with Tommy Joe Stonefield, defying her family's hatred of their neighbors and hoping they can find a way to be together.

faq.q: What threats do the vineyards face?
faq.answer: The vineyards face family disputes, hungry wild boars that trample crops and vines, and kobolds from nearby gold mines who raid the surrounding fields.

faq.q: What do the Maclures produce here?
faq.answer: The Maclure family grows grapes for wine and fresh fruit. Their produce goes to tavern-keepers and merchants throughout Elwynn Forest and Stormwind City.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, the feud shows the stubbornness of the countryside. Even in the kingdom's heartland, neighbors quarrel over fences while greater perils loom.
The estate supplies food and spirits to nearby Goldshire and Stormwind City.
